assessment.headline: DAY 37. F-15E officer RESCUED. India buying Iranian oil. But 'all Hell' threatened for TOMORROW. The clock is ticking.
assessment.body:
The most dramatic 24 hours of the war produced three outcomes that each reshape India's calculus:

1. F-15E WSO RESCUED. The colonel hid for 36+ hours in a mountain crevice in Iran's Khuzestan province with a pistol and tracking beacon. US commandos swarmed the mountains, dropped bombs to clear the area, and extracted him — 'seriously wounded but really brave.' A CIA deception campaign helped throw off Iranian search parties. This removes the POW crisis risk and is a massive morale boost for the US military.

2. INDIA OFFICIALLY BUYING IRANIAN OIL. The Ministry of Petroleum confirmed India is purchasing Iranian crude for the first time in 7 years — since US sanctions in 2019. This is under a US temporary license for 140M barrels. India is now simultaneously buying from USA (#1 LPG supplier), Russia, Iran, and Australia. This is the most aggressive 'all sides' energy diplomacy India has ever conducted.

3. TRUMP'S 'ALL HELL' ULTIMATUM. April 6 = TOMORROW. Deadline expires Monday 5:30 AM IST. If Hormuz is not reopened: power plants + bridges will be struck. Iran REJECTED the ultimatum — called it 'helpless, nervous.' Iran's military: 'gates of hell will open on YOU if infrastructure attacks expand.'

Also today: Iran claims it downed 2 C-130 transport planes and 2 Black Hawk helicopters (unconfirmed by CENTCOM). Rosatom evacuated 200 staff from Bushehr 'minutes before it was hit.' Tel Aviv saw 1,000+ protesters defying police. Pope Leo urged peace. Kuwait intercepted 8 missiles + 19 drones in 24 hours.

For India (Day 37, 7:15 PM):
• Green Sanvi reaches MUMBAI TOMORROW — 46,650 MT LPG
• India officially buying Iranian oil (first in 7 years)
• 9 carriers crossed. 17 ships + 460 seafarers. Green Asha + Jag Vikram next
• 60 days fuel stock. LPG 30+ days. Refineries >100%
• India supplying fuel to 5 neighbors
• Rupee 93.19 (RBI holding)

MONDAY SCENARIOS:
• If April 6 passes peacefully: relief rally. Brent drops. Sensex +1,000
• If power plants struck: Brent $130+. Sensex crash 2,000+. Rupee under pressure
• If deal announced: massive rally. Brent to $85. FII returns

The rescued WSO is the human story. India buying Iranian oil is the strategic story. The April 6 deadline is the crisis story. All three converge Monday morning.
